submitted.rationale: EQE was measured at 5 points along the line. The highest value was at Sb 0.17 (index 1, 0.0091%). EQE fell toward the rutile FeSbO4 composition (0.0034% at Sb 0.29 and 0.0017% at Sb 0.51) and was negative at Sb 0.69. It also dropped at Sb 0.15 (0.0055%). So the maximum is near the Fe-rich end, around Sb 0.17–0.2. The spacing between points is coarse, so the true peak could lie at index 2 or 3.
